messages:
maya.patel: Heads-up: finishing publisher onboarding for AWS/GCP/Azure today. Staging manifests accepted by consoles but publishing blocked by missing offer roles, trial EULA copy, and Azure metering tags. Can we confirm owners and blockers? :mag:

jordan_sales: I'll own AWS offer ingestion + mapping to our hero SKU. Need confirmation of the expected offer ID format and whether we should include free-tier metering tag.

olivia.ross: Terraform module is updated in partnerships infra repo. See https://git.redwood/repo/partnerships/terraform/marketplace-staging. I added an example output and a small helper to generate role ARNs.

```hcl
output "publisher_role_arn" {
  value = aws_iam_role.marketplace_publisher.arn
}
```

samir.gupta: On GCP side, I created a service account and binding PR. Important: enable Cloud Marketplace Entitlement and Billing APIs in the publisher project (billing API required for metering labels). PR: https://git.redwood/repo/partnerships/pull/256

sally_legal: Legal note: marketplace trial must be <= 14 days and require explicit opt-in language. Draft trial CTA: "Start a free 14-day trial — no credit card required. By starting you agree to Redwood Marketplace Trial Terms and our Data Use policy." I'll attach clause references once final.

jordan_sales: Uploaded assets to s3://redwood-marketplace-staging/sku-099/v1/ and set public-read for publisher ingest tests. Proposed AWS offer ID: com.redwood:sku-099. Can we include a short demo image in the UI? If so, need the path.

olivia.ross: Azure manifest needs: VHD blob path, pricing meter id, and a metering tag key `redwood:metering`. I've added a TODO in the manifest template. Also request SAS URL for the VHD since our ingest job runs from the publisher account.

deploy-bot: CI: manifest schema validation will run on merge. Missing fields will fail publishing pipeline.

maya.patel: Owners recap: Jordan -> AWS assets & offer; Samir -> GCP SA + APIs; Olivia -> infra + Azure manifest; Sally -> legal copy + EULA clause. Target publish: Thu 09:00 PT. If any blocker, flag here and we'll escalate to platform SRE.

samir.gupta: Note: GCP partner enrollment step is required before final publish. I can start the enrollment, but need billing owner to confirm account selector.

jordan_sales: Confirmed AWS role ARN: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-marketplace-publisher-staging and publishing tests accept the role. Adding hero SKU metadata now.

sally_legal: Added EULA snippet with clause 3.2 on data retention. I'll circulate final copy in a PR to the marketplace repo.

olivia.ross: Pushed README with step-by-step publish instructions and the terraform output variables we rely on. Will also add a small smoke test that hits the publisher console.

maya.patel: Thanks. I'll assemble the final checklist and post back once all assets validate in staging. :rocket:
